Record paired hit indicators for each model on identical users and candidate sets. Estimate Δ = (1/4)Σc meanᵢ(hitA−hitB). Recommended stratified paired bootstrap: independently resample 200 users with replacement within each category, preserve both models’ outcomes together, and recompute Δ over ≥10,000 replicates. Report category HR@10, macro HR@10, paired Δ in percentage points, and its 95% percentile interval; disclose bootstrap seed and method. Pair-preserving resampling follows [SciPy’s bootstrap documentation](https://docs.scipy.org/doc/scipy/reference/generated/scipy.stats.bootstrap.html). This interval describes user-sampling uncertainty conditional on fitted models, fixed categories and candidate panels; it excludes training-seed and negative-sampling variability. The observed fixed-panel score itself is deterministic.

For binary-outcome testing, report discordant counts: A-only hits versus B-only hits. Exact McNemar uses a Binomial(discordant total, 0.5) null and handles sparse discordances; see [Stata’s paired-classifier explanation](https://blog.stata.com/2025/04/22/approximate-statistical-tests-for-comparing-binary-classifier-error-rates-using-h2oml/). With equal category sizes, pooled discordance testing aligns with the macro difference, under independent pairs and the corresponding marginal-equality null. Category-specific tests reveal heterogeneity; apply Holm correction if making four inferential claims. Keep effect intervals alongside p-values.

Repeated hyperparameter/checkpoint selection makes ordinary winner intervals optimistic; bootstrapping only the selected winner cannot correct this. [Cawley–Talbot](https://jmlr.csail.mit.edu/beta/papers/v11/cawley10a.html) document selection overfitting. For this pinned protocol, predeclare search budget, checkpoint cadence, stopping/tie rules and practically meaningful improvement; log every evaluated configuration/checkpoint. Multiplicity correction supports prespecified comparison families but does not generally repair adaptive search. Treat validation intervals as exploratory, explicitly disclose panel reuse, freeze the final choice, and leave independent held-out evaluation to the host.
